comments.value: The user and the mod accepting the invite should have the warning ingame

comments.mergedPostDetails:
Setup:

 - A group owner has set the group joining mechanism "Open to New Members" to "Request Invite"

- A user who already joined the maximum allowed number of groups wants to join that group

Current behavior:

The group owner gets a notification about the join request but can't resolve it or message the user back. His only options are: ignore or decline the request.

Instead what should happen:

When a user has already joined the maximum allowed number of groups he should not be able to request to join a group. Instead he should receive an error message: "You can not join any more groups as you have already joined the maximum allowed number of groups."
comments.mergedPostTitle: Groups: Request Invite behavior (when user joined max number of groups)

comments.value:
Bumping this up as it's still an issue and there is still no notification on either end for requests to join that meet this condition.

I'll add that the user should probably receive a notification back when the group tries and fails to accept their invite rather than requesting since there are situations where the group cap for users can change such as an expiring vrc+ subscription.

Currently, if a user who already reached the maximum number of groups sends a join request, the group moderators receive the request but cannot approve it.

The error only appears when moderators try to accept the request.

This seems backwards from a UX perspective.

Instead, the system should check the group limit when the user sends the join request and prevent the request from being sent in the first place.

Showing an error message like:

"You cannot request to join this group because you have reached the maximum number of groups."

would prevent unnecessary requests and confusion for both users and moderators.
This is still an issue every week for our dance club. Can we please work on this?
There's a lot of things that don't warn you if you're maxed out. Groups is a very big one.

Every week we have to decline 2 to 5 people because of this design oversight.

It is hindering engagement in on two fronts: in groups and VRChat in general.

Would be nice if it gets addressed at some point....

We have to "abuse" the VRChat group rules description of our group to be able to notify users about this issue. This is how the group rule descriptions for ALL "request to join" groups should currently look like:

We CAN'T ACCEPT your join request and are FORCED TO DENY IT if you MAXED OUT your group limit in VRChat.

This limits are: 100 groups (non VRC+)  200 groups (VRC+)

JOIN our DISCORD˸ to make sure to be accepted into this group․ Use the discord link available on the group page to get there․

details:
Hi, I manage a Vrchat group for workouts. We get many requests to join a group that are often maxed out on groups. As a result, we cannot accept their request as a result. 

Furthermore, there is no error in the game for this error, only in the api.
title: Warn users if they are maxxed out on groups when requesting to join a group
